## What it is
rag-shared is a shared utilities package for RAG orchestration services. It provides readable logging, optional OpenTelemetry observability, and a Dragonfly/Redis cache client for inter-service data sharing.

## Current capabilities
- Readable Logging: Milvus-style format for terminal and Grafana readability
- OpenTelemetry Observability: Distributed tracing with optional OTLP export
- Dragonfly/Redis Client: Cache client for storing/retrieving Python objects using environment variables
